title: Sparkly guitar
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='bodyGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e8431f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c22a10'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='neckGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#d4943a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b07620'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe94d'>
    <polygon points='14,18 16,24 22,24 17,28 19,34 14,30 9,34 11,28 6,24 12,24'/>
    <polygon points='86,12 87.5,16.5 92,18 87.5,19.5 86,24 84.5,19.5 80,18 84.5,16.5'/>
    <polygon points='88,64 89.5,68 93.5,69.5 89.5,71 88,75 86.5,71 82.5,69.5 86.5,68'/>
    <polygon points='8,72 9.5,76 13.5,77.5 9.5,79 8,83 6.5,79 2.5,77.5 6.5,76'/>
    <polygon points='50,4 51.5,7.5 55,9 51.5,10.5 50,14 48.5,10.5 45,9 48.5,7.5'/>
  </g>

  <!-- small star sparkles -->
  <g fill='#7df9ff'>
    <circle cx='24' cy='52' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='78' cy='42' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='88' r='2.2'/>
    <circle cx='34' cy='92' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='60' cy='10' r='1.5'/>
  </g>

  <!-- guitar neck -->
  <rect x='44' y='14' width='12' height='42' rx='3' fill='url(#neckGrad)'/>
  <!-- fret lines -->
  <g stroke='#8a5a10' stroke-width='1'>
    <line x1='44' y1='22' x2='56' y2='22'/>
    <line x1='44' y1='30' x2='56' y2='30'/>
    <line x1='44' y1='38' x2='56' y2='38'/>
    <line x1='44' y1='46' x2='56' y2='46'/>
  </g>

  <!-- headstock -->
  <rect x='42' y='6' width='16' height='12' rx='3' fill='#8b4513'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='12' r='2' fill='#ffe94d'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='12' r='2' fill='#ffe94d'/>

  <!-- guitar body - upper bout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='24' ry='18' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>
  <!-- guitar body - lower bout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='20' ry='14' fill='#d63a18'/>
  <!-- body rim highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='24' ry='18' fill='none' stroke='#ff7b55' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='20' ry='14' fill='none' stroke='#ff7b55' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- sound hole -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='66' r='8' fill='#3a0a00'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='66' r='9' fill='none' stroke='#ffb347' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- bridge -->
  <rect x='42' y='82' width='16' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffe0a3'/>

  <!-- strings -->
  <g stroke='#fffbe0' stroke-width='0.8'>
    <line x1='47' y1='14' x2='47' y2='82'/>
    <line x1='49' y1='14' x2='49' y2='82'/>
    <line x1='51' y1='14' x2='51' y2='82'/>
    <line x1='53' y1='14' x2='53' y2='82'/>
  </g>

  <!-- tuning pegs -->
  <g fill='#ffe94d'>
    <rect x='38' y='8' width='5' height='2' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='38' y='12' width='5' height='2' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='57' y='8' width='5' height='2' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='57' y='12' width='5' height='2' rx='1'/>
  </g>
</svg>
